obligations.target: Prove that the main page view or template renders input parameter fields and execution controls for API operations.
obligations.reason: Unit tests on the page rendering logic verify that input controls and the execution trigger are present in the response markup. Would gain e2e-playwright coverage at thorough.

obligations.target: Prove that running an API call with a single custom parameter value executes correctly and yields results reflecting the parameter.
obligations.reason: Unit tests verify request handling, parameter forwarding, and response rendering for a single parameter value. Would gain e2e-playwright coverage at thorough.

obligations.target: Prove that running an API call with multiple custom parameter values executes properly and reflects all supplied values in the result.

obligations.target: Prove that omitting a required parameter triggers a validation error message and halts successful execution.
obligations.reason: Unit tests verify parameter presence validation rules and negative response or error rendering. Would gain e2e-playwright coverage at thorough.

obligations.target: Prove that providing an invalid parameter format displays an error message or validation indicator alerting the user.
obligations.reason: Unit tests verify format validation routines and error message output when parameter constraints are violated. Would gain e2e-playwright coverage at thorough.

obligations.target: Prove that updating parameter values and re-triggering the call produces an updated result reflecting the new inputs.
